entries.title: Folders for boards and results in Google Sheets

items.text: Writing results can go to a Google Sheet. The sheet lists each student and their word count.
Board collections are now called folders. They work like the folders in your quiz and video libraries.
Guided Learning results go to a Google Sheet instead of a CSV download.

widgetNotes.text: Writing results can go to a Google Sheet with each student and their word count.
Results now go to a Google Sheet instead of a CSV download.
Printed response sheets always show the questions. True or false questions print two bubbles.
